name: Truly International Holdings Limited
summary: Truly International Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, manufactures and sells liquid crystal display (LCD) products and electronic consumer products. It operates through LCD Products and Electronic Consumer Products segments. The company offers touch panel products and modules; compact camera modules; personal health care products and electrical devices, including electric toothbrushes, blood glucose and pressure monitors; calculators; printed circuit board panels and plastic injection molding products for various applications; cover lens; and fingerprint identification modules.
